i recently came across the pi entertainment system and decided to give it a spin. they offer direct download links and torrents for the image and the following emulators are supported out of the box, except for the ones needing BIOS files (gba, psx, etc. BIOS files go in /data/pes/BIOS/):

Atari 2600
Commodore64
Final Burn Alpha (FBA)
MAME
MSX
Nintendo 64
Nintendo Entertainment System (NES)
Nintendo GameBoy
Nintendo GameBoy Advance
Nintendo GameBoy Color
Nintendo Super Entertainment System (SNES)
Sega CD
Sega Game Gear
Sega Master System
Sega Mega Drive (aka Genesis)
Sega Mega Drive (aka Genesis) 32X
Sony PlayStation
Sony PSP (Raspberry Pi 2/3 only)
Turbo Grafx 16 (aka PC Engine)
ZX Spectrum

i had to go into the PES consoles.ini config (by default located at /data/pes/conf.d/pes/consoles.ini) to add support for n64 roms ending in .z64 or .n64, as well as add support for .cue files for the playstation (edit the "extensions" lines).

/data/ is on its own partition, and PES comes with first run scripts to inflate any unpartitioned space into this partition.

i have tested games on the nes, snes, psx, n64, and gba. aside from the usual n64 emulation headaches everything seems to runs quite well. i wish it had support for kodi or youtube-dl or mpsyt... some sort of internet streaming service. the maintainer of the project "may" add support for kodi in the future, but for the moment it's just the games.

additionally, pes comes pre-installed with the sixaxis pair tool and makes it pretty easy to pair your ps3 controller to your system (2x easier also if you're running a pi3 with built in bluetooth) as well as support for wired controller support (you must comment out the single line in /etc/udev/rules.d/97-sixpair.rules for wired support (prepend the line with a '#')).

i've tried compiling retroarch from source as well as various other emulator solutions and this was easily one of the most inclusive and painless installations i have ever encountered. give it a shot if you've been looking for an emulation solution.

pose any questions in the comments and i'll try to answer as best i can (i am not the maintainer of the PES image, only a new fan)
